# Model asset licensing

Excluded from blanket Apache relicensing. See root LICENSE_SCOPE.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
KoELECTRA base encoder/vocabulary: upstream Apache-2.0, indirectly obtained through kakaotalk-chat-analyzer-models@0.2.1 (MIT metadata); byte provenance unverified. Fine-tuned weights/heads retain existing CC-BY-SA-4.0 declarations. Training includes 3i4k by warnikchow and contributors (https://github.com/warnikchow/3i4k) and synthetic data. Changes recorded: fine-tuning, int8 quantization, task heads and JSON/JS/base64 packaging. See models/v46/MODEL_CARD.md and apps/shared/nlp/NLP_ASSETS_MANIFEST.json for hashes/history. Preserve applicable full license texts and notices when copying. This notice does not resolve provenance or change model bytes.
